hotplug_iface:
#!/bin/sh
# WAN/STA identity changes: debounce, then one multidial. Logs for tuning.

[ "$ACTION" = "ifup" -o "$ACTION" = "ifupdate" -o "$ACTION" = "ifdown" ] || exit 0
case "$INTERFACE" in
	wan|wan6|wwan|wwan*|vwan*) ;;
	*)
		case "$DEVICE" in
			phy*-sta*|wlan*|apcli*) ;;
			*) exit 0 ;;
		esac
		;;
esac

mkdir -p /tmp/hotel
echo "{\"ts\":$(date +%s),\"action\":\"$ACTION\",\"iface\":\"$INTERFACE\",\"dev\":\"$DEVICE\"}" >> /tmp/hotel/hotplug.jsonl
touch /tmp/hotel-burst

flag=/var/run/hotel-hp.pending
if [ -f "$flag" ]; then
hotplug_net:
#!/bin/sh
[ "$ACTION" = "add" -o "$ACTION" = "register" -o "$ACTION" = "remove" -o "$ACTION" = "unregister" ] || exit 0
dev="${DEVICE:-$INTERFACE}"
if [ "$dev" = wan ]; then
	if [ "$ACTION" = "add" -o "$ACTION" = "register" ]; then
		[ -x /usr/sbin/hotel-perf.sh ] && /usr/sbin/hotel-perf.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
	fi
	[ -x /usr/sbin/hotel-guard.sh ] && /usr/sbin/hotel-guard.sh sta >/dev/null 2>&1 &
elif [ -n "$dev" ] && [ "$ACTION" = "add" -o "$ACTION" = "register" ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/hotel-perf.sh ]; then
	/usr/sbin/hotel-perf.sh iface "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi
[ -x /usr/sbin/hotel-led.sh ] && /usr/sbin/hotel-led.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
exit 0
rc_local:
# Boot stack is S99hotel-multidial (perf/dns/harvest) then S99hotel-proxy.
# Safety net only — do not duplicate a healthy S99 boot.
mkdir -p /tmp/hotel
pidof smartdns >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/sbin/hotel-dns.sh apply >/tmp/hotel/dns.log 2>&1
[ -f /tmp/hotel-online ] || /usr/sbin/hotel-multidial.sh >/tmp/hotel-multidial.log 2>&1
pidof mihomo >/dev/null 2>&1 || /etc/init.d/hotel-proxy start >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
